terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.s1_body: By creating an account, accessing, or using Zoneploy, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you use the Service on behalf of a company, organization, or client, you confirm that you are authorized to bind that entity to these Terms.
terms.s2_body: Zoneploy provides software and hosted services for managing deployments on infrastructure you connect to the platform, including organizations, remote servers, containers, stacks, domains, secrets, logs, metrics, add-ons, and the Server Agent. Unless we explicitly state otherwise, you remain responsible for the underlying cloud or VPS costs, the workloads you run, and the third-party services you connect.
s3_items: Providing accurate account information and keeping your email address verified and up to date.
Protecting your password, passkeys, MFA devices, API tokens, and any other credentials associated with your account or organization.
Managing invitations, roles, and permissions inside your organizations so only authorized people can operate your infrastructure.
Promptly notifying us if you believe your account, organization, or connected infrastructure has been compromised.
terms.s4_body: When you connect a server, you authorize Zoneploy to install and communicate with the Server Agent on that machine and to perform the actions requested through the product by authorized members of your organization. privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_body: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data Zoneploy collects, how we use it, and the choices available to you. Zoneploy is a platform for operating deployments on infrastructure connected by our customers. The Service is intended for business and professional use and is not directed to children under 16.
privacy.s2_intro: Depending on how you use the Service, we may collect:
s2_items: Account and profile data, such as name, email address, password hash, avatar, verification status, MFA configuration, session records, and linked social login identities.
Organization and collaboration data, such as organization names, memberships, invitations, roles, audit events, and account-level preferences.

Deployment and infrastructure data, such as server IP addresses, hostnames, environment and deployment configuration, secrets submitted through the product, domains, logs, metrics, and runtime metadata reported by the Server Agent.
Support, billing, and transactional data, such as invoices, subscription events, payment provider references, support messages, and emails we send for verification, invitations, and security actions.
s3_items: Create and manage accounts, organizations, authentication flows, and security controls.
Operate the core product, including remote server connections, deployments, domains, add-ons, logs, metrics, notifications, and audit history.
Send transactional communications such as verification emails, password resets, invitations, billing notices, and important service updates.
Prevent abuse, investigate incidents, enforce our Terms, detect fraud or suspicious activity, and improve reliability, support, and product decisions.
privacy.s4_body: Most of the data we process comes directly from you, members of your organization, connected servers, or integrations you choose to enable. If you sign in with Google or GitHub, we also receive identity data from those providers. Where applicable, we process personal data to perform our contract with you, to comply with legal obligations, to pursue legitimate interests such as security and service improvement, and in limited cases based on consent where required by law.
privacy.s5_body: We do not sell your personal data. We may share it with service providers that help us operate Zoneploy, such as hosting, database, email, authentication, DNS, observability, and payment providers, as well as with members of your organization based on your permissions model. We may also disclose information when required by law, to protect the security or rights of Zoneploy or others, or as part of a merger, acquisition, or asset transfer.
privacy.s6_body: Zoneploy and its service providers may process data in countries other than the one where you are located. When that happens, we rely on appropriate contractual, organizational, and technical safeguards designed to protect personal data in line with applicable law.
privacy.s7_body: We keep personal data for as long as needed to provide the Service, maintain security, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, and comply with legal, tax, or accounting obligations. Retention periods vary by data type. When data is no longer needed, we delete it, anonymize it, or isolate it from normal product use, subject to backup and legal retention constraints.
privacy.s8_body: We use a combination of technical and organizational safeguards, including encryption for sensitive values where supported by the product, access controls, short-lived tokens, auditability features, and TLS in transit. No system is completely secure, and you remain responsible for securing your own endpoints, credentials, infrastructure, and backups.
privacy.s9_body: To operate the Service, Zoneploy may process deployment configuration, secrets, domains, logs, terminal output, and runtime metadata that you or authorized members of your organization submit or enable. The Server Agent also reports status and operational data from connected servers. We do not routinely inspect the business content stored inside your applications or databases unless doing so is necessary to provide a feature you actively use, to troubleshoot with authorization, or to comply with law or a security obligation.
privacy.s10_title: 10. Cookies, Local Storage, and Similar Technologies
privacy.s10_body: We use essential cookies and local storage to keep you signed in, remember language and theme preferences, preserve pending authentication state, and operate security features such as MFA or OAuth. We do not rely on third-party advertising cookies within the product experience.
privacy.s11_intro: Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have the right to:
s11_items: Access the personal data we hold about you.
Request correction, deletion, restriction, or portability of certain personal data.
Object to certain processing, including processing based on legitimate interests where applicable.
Withdraw consent where processing depends on consent.
Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority or data protection regulator.
